blueprints.name: State Machine Contract Generator
blueprints.goal: Turn important automation lifecycle rules into explicit states and allowed transitions.

blueprints.name: Invariant Registry
blueprints.goal: Store properties that must remain true before and after every repair.

blueprints.name: Precondition Validator
blueprints.goal: Reject a job when required environmental assumptions are not proven.

blueprints.name: Postcondition Validator
blueprints.goal: Verify the promised outcome after execution.

blueprints.name: Transition Safety Checker
blueprints.goal: Detect invalid state transitions before they change repository state.

blueprints.name: Idempotency Contract Tester
blueprints.goal: Verify repeated execution produces no unintended additional mutation.

blueprints.name: Transaction Boundary Mapper
blueprints.goal: Identify which operations must succeed or rollback together.

blueprints.name: Consistency Rule Engine
blueprints.goal: Check consistency across GitHub state, local state and generated reports.

blueprints.name: Recovery State Machine
blueprints.goal: Model recovery as deterministic states instead of ad-hoc retry logic.

blueprints.name: Formal Gate Explainer
blueprints.goal: Explain which invariant or gate prevented an action.

blueprints.name: Distributed Cycle Trace
blueprints.goal: Assign one correlation ID across scout, council, worker, test and result records.

blueprints.name: Decision Trace Explorer
blueprints.goal: Reconstruct why a specific action was selected.

blueprints.name: Repository Event Timeline
blueprints.goal: Combine commits, workflows, pull requests and failures into one timeline.

blueprints.name: Signal Noise Classifier
blueprints.goal: Separate actionable signals from repetitive operational noise.

blueprints.name: Silent Degradation Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect performance or reliability decline without an explicit workflow failure.

blueprints.name: Evidence Freshness Monitor
blueprints.goal: Expire evidence when the source is too old to justify a current action.

blueprints.name: Cross Repository Incident Correlator
blueprints.goal: Detect the same root symptom across multiple repositories.

blueprints.name: Health Trend Analyzer
blueprints.goal: Track whether repository health improves or deteriorates over multiple cycles.

blueprints.name: Automation Coverage Map
blueprints.goal: Map which repository risks currently have automated detection or recovery.

blueprints.name: Explainable Alert Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate alerts containing evidence, impact and smallest useful next action.

blueprints.name: Canary Release Planner
blueprints.goal: Prepare a limited-scope release before full deployment.

blueprints.name: Release Channel Manager
blueprints.goal: Separate LAB, alpha, beta, release candidate and stable states.

blueprints.name: Feature Flag Registry
blueprints.goal: Keep risky new capabilities disabled until explicitly promoted.

blueprints.name: Rollback Evidence Bundle
blueprints.goal: Capture exactly what is needed to reverse a deployment.

blueprints.name: Release Diff Summarizer
blueprints.goal: Explain meaningful release changes instead of listing raw commits.

blueprints.name: Compatibility Window Manager
blueprints.goal: Track supported versions and migration windows.

blueprints.name: Deployment Gate Matrix
blueprints.goal: Define different required gates for website, automation, package and runtime changes.

blueprints.name: Post Deployment Verification
blueprints.goal: Re-test real public behavior after deployment.

blueprints.name: Release Freeze Controller
blueprints.goal: Pause nonessential development during incidents.

blueprints.name: Release Confidence Score
blueprints.goal: Combine tests, failures, rollback readiness and historical reliability.

blueprints.name: Documentation Drift Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect documentation that no longer matches current behavior.

blueprints.name: README Reality Checker
blueprints.goal: Compare README claims with repository structure and available commands.

blueprints.name: Command Example Tester
blueprints.goal: Test documented shell commands in a safe environment.

blueprints.name: Architecture Diagram Generator
blueprints.goal: Generate repository and service maps from evidence.

blueprints.name: Runbook Generator
blueprints.goal: Create incident and recovery instructions from verified workflows.

blueprints.name: Decision Record Generator
blueprints.goal: Create architecture decision records for important system choices.

blueprints.name: User Journey Documentation
blueprints.goal: Document how a real user reaches a useful outcome.

blueprints.name: Accessibility Documentation Gate
blueprints.goal: Require accessibility considerations for public-facing features.

blueprints.name: Internationalization Readiness
blueprints.goal: Detect hard-coded user text that blocks translation.

blueprints.name: Documentation Retirement Engine
blueprints.goal: Archive obsolete instructions to reduce confusion.

blueprints.name: Runtime Profiler
blueprints.goal: Measure which automation stages consume the most time.

blueprints.name: GitHub API Budget Optimizer
blueprints.goal: Reduce redundant API requests and rate-limit pressure.

blueprints.name: Termux CPU Budget
blueprints.goal: Limit background work under high device load.

blueprints.name: Termux Memory Budget
blueprints.goal: Avoid launching excessive workers when available memory is low.

blueprints.name: Battery Cost Profiler
blueprints.goal: Measure battery impact of recurring local automation.

blueprints.name: Network Cost Profiler
blueprints.goal: Reduce unnecessary network traffic.

blueprints.name: Incremental Repository Scanner
blueprints.goal: Re-scan only changed surfaces when safe.

blueprints.name: Cache Validity Engine
blueprints.goal: Cache expensive observations with explicit freshness rules.

blueprints.name: Parallel Safe Read Planner
blueprints.goal: Run independent read-only scouts concurrently while serializing writes.

blueprints.name: Performance Regression Gate
blueprints.goal: Reject changes causing unreasonable runtime growth.

blueprints.name: Worker Capability Registry
blueprints.goal: Record which worker types have proven useful for which tasks.

blueprints.name: Worker Success Calibration
blueprints.goal: Update worker confidence using actual outcomes.

blueprints.name: Worker Failure Cooldown
blueprints.goal: Temporarily reduce selection of repeatedly failing worker strategies.

blueprints.name: Worker Pairing Engine
blueprints.goal: Pair complementary workers such as implementation plus critic.

blueprints.name: Scout To Worker Handoff
blueprints.goal: Convert research findings into bounded engineering tasks.

blueprints.name: Council Conflict Resolver
blueprints.goal: Resolve incompatible recommendations using evidence strength.

blueprints.name: Work In Progress Governor
blueprints.goal: Prevent too many unfinished projects and pull requests.

blueprints.name: Repository Ownership Router
blueprints.goal: Send tasks to the correct existing repository.

blueprints.name: Cross Repository Dependency Planner
blueprints.goal: Order changes when multiple repositories depend on each other.

blueprints.name: Coordination Deadlock Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect cycles where every task waits on another task.

blueprints.name: Permission Minimization Auditor
blueprints.goal: Inspect workflows for permissions broader than necessary.

blueprints.name: Workflow Trigger Auditor
blueprints.goal: Detect dangerous or redundant workflow triggers.

blueprints.name: Action Version Risk Monitor
blueprints.goal: Track major GitHub Action upgrades requiring validation.

blueprints.name: Pull Request Supersession Detector
blueprints.goal: Identify older pull requests replaced by newer work.

blueprints.name: Pull Request Scope Guard
blueprints.goal: Reject excessively broad unrelated changes.

blueprints.name: Branch Hygiene Planner
blueprints.goal: Identify obsolete bot branches after completed work.

blueprints.name: Repository Sprawl Governor
blueprints.goal: Reject new repositories when an existing repository can own the capability.

blueprints.name: Dependency PR Triage
blueprints.goal: Separate safe patch updates from breaking migrations.

blueprints.name: Workflow Failure Fingerprinter
blueprints.goal: Canonicalize recurring GitHub Actions failure signatures.

blueprints.name: GitHub Recovery Planner
blueprints.goal: Generate the smallest safe repair sequence for failed repository automation.

blueprints.name: User Value Evidence Register
blueprints.goal: Require evidence that a capability solves a real problem.

blueprints.name: Feature Usage Hypothesis
blueprints.goal: State how a feature is expected to create measurable utility.

blueprints.name: MVP Boundary Guard
blueprints.goal: Prevent prototypes from expanding before core value is proven.

blueprints.name: Product Complexity Budget
blueprints.goal: Track maintenance complexity added per useful capability.

blueprints.name: Feature Retirement Candidate
blueprints.goal: Identify unused or low-value capabilities.

blueprints.name: Public Claim Verifier
blueprints.goal: Prevent website claims exceeding proven capability.

blueprints.name: LAB Promotion Gate
blueprints.goal: Define evidence required to promote LAB to beta.

blueprints.name: Beta Promotion Gate
blueprints.goal: Define evidence required to promote beta to stable.

blueprints.name: Feedback Classification Engine
blueprints.goal: Convert user feedback into bugs, requests, evidence or noise.

blueprints.name: Outcome Based Roadmap
blueprints.goal: Rank development by measured outcome instead of feature count.

blueprints.name: Backup Restore Drill
blueprints.goal: Periodically verify backups can actually be restored.

blueprints.name: Recovery Point Objective Monitor
blueprints.goal: Measure potential state loss after failure.

blueprints.name: Recovery Time Objective Monitor
blueprints.goal: Measure expected recovery duration.

blueprints.name: Scheduler Redundancy Checker
blueprints.goal: Detect reliance on one fragile scheduling path.

blueprints.name: Offline Operation Planner
blueprints.goal: Define behavior when GitHub or internet access is unavailable.

blueprints.name: Reconciliation Engine
blueprints.goal: Safely reconcile local and GitHub state after reconnect.

blueprints.name: Checkpoint Integrity Verifier
blueprints.goal: Hash and verify important recovery checkpoints.

blueprints.name: Configuration Drift Repair Planner
blueprints.goal: Detect divergence between intended and actual configuration.

blueprints.name: Dependency Failure Isolation
blueprints.goal: Prevent one failed optional service from stopping the whole system.

blueprints.name: Resilience Proof Report
blueprints.goal: Summarize which failures have actually been tested and recovered from.

blueprints.name: Expected Versus Actual Impact
blueprints.goal: Compare blueprint impact predictions with observed results.

blueprints.name: Score Calibration Engine
blueprints.goal: Correct ranking formulas that consistently overestimate certain work.

blueprints.name: False Progress Detector
blueprints.goal: Detect activity such as commits or bot counts without measurable capability gain.

blueprints.name: Automation Debt Register
blueprints.goal: Track automation that itself creates maintenance burden.

blueprints.name: Complexity To Value Ratio
blueprints.goal: Measure value gained for each unit of complexity introduced.

blueprints.name: System Simplification Planner
blueprints.goal: Find components that can be merged or removed.

blueprints.name: Unknown Capability Discovery
blueprints.goal: Search recurring failures for missing classes of tools or knowledge.

blueprints.name: Benchmark Evolution Engine
blueprints.goal: Expand benchmarks only when a new failure class is observed.

blueprints.name: Constitution Compliance Auditor
blueprints.goal: Verify automation behavior matches the Mikis13 safety constitution.

blueprints.name: V10 Architecture Review
blueprints.goal: Run a periodic review of capability, reliability, complexity, evidence and owner control.
